## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, the change and related issues or roadmap items.
English or Russian is welcome.

## Validation

List exact commands, results and the tested commits/JARs. State checks not run.
For game checks include tick rate, bounded scenario and small redacted evidence.
Do not treat historical results as validation of a new build.

## Compatibility and dependencies

Describe save migrations, changed APIs and affected consumer revisions/PRs.
Mention third-party or generated material and its review/attribution, if any.

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md and applicable AGENTS.md rules.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, copied worlds, game binaries or caches are included.
- [ ] Validation limits and known failures are stated accurately.
